issue.title: syncd crash in syncd::VendorSai::logSet() during docker startup

failure.body:
#### Description
We have observed this syncd crash once on single asic system recentl during config reload:

(gdb) bt

resolution.title: [syncd] Move logSet logGet under mutex to prevent race condition
resolution.description:
Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/21180

Mutex is added to protect m_logLevelMap when doing logSet from multiple thread

related_prs.title: [Rebase for #1505][syncd] Move logSet logGet under mutex to prevent race condition
